cause_quote: The introducing diff computed the match with `fold(props.name).indexOf(fold(query))` and used that offset in `props.name.slice(index, index + query.length)`, which misplaces the highlight when folding changes the string length.
user_saw: When searching for Korean or decomposed accented author names in Dashboards, users saw the wrong letters bolded or no bolding at all.
summary: The fix maps each folded search match back to the corresponding span in the original author name while preserving which authors match.
reasoning: The introducing diff replaced the previous author picker, which displayed plain labels without an author search field, with a searchable picker that bolded matches. Its first implementation used offsets from the folded name to slice the original string, so the highlighting defect shipped with the feature.
